info.title: GoWay events
info.description:
Domain events the GoWay services publish to NATS JetStream (stream `GOWAY`). A Python service writes the event
into its outbox inside the same transaction as the change, and a relay publishes it with the outbox row id as
`event_id`; goway-realtime publishes straight to JetStream and stamps a random `event_id` itself. Delivery is at
least once, so every consumer dedupes on `event_id`. Payloads only grow within a version: a field is never
renamed, retyped or removed, and a breaking change gets a new subject ending in `.v2`. `x-consumers` lists the
services whose handlers act on a subject; a wildcard subscription that only passes it by is not listed.

nats.description: NATS JetStream inside the GoWay network.

payload.title: UserCreated
payload.description: An account came into being. Three paths publish it with different fields: self-signup sends `account_type`; an admin create sends `first_name` and `last_name`, either of which may be null; an admin restore of a soft-deleted account sends `updated_at`. `user_id`, `org_id`, `role`, `phone` and `language` are always sent.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

role.description: Role name. Self-signup sends `shipper` or `carrier`, an admin create the role it picked, a restore the stored role or an empty string when the user has none.

phone.description: E.164 number, `+998…`. A restore sends the stored value, which is `del:…` for an account its owner deleted.

language.description: App language code: uz, uzc, ru, en, kaa or zh.

first_name.description: Admin create only; null when the admin gave none.

last_name.description: Admin create only; null when the admin gave none.

updated_at.description: Admin restore only: when the account came back. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

payload.title: UserUpdated
payload.description: Something about an account changed. Only what changed is sent, besides `user_id` and `updated_at`, and five paths send five field sets: a confirmed phone change sends `phone`; the account settings screen any of `language`, `currency`, `theme`, `notification_prefs`; a role switch `role`; an admin edit any of `phone`, `language`, `first_name`, `last_name`, plus `role` whenever the admin named one; a profile edit `first_name`, `last_name`, `email` and `avatar_url` together, each of them possibly null.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

language.description: App language code: uz, uzc, ru, en, kaa or zh.

currency.title: DisplayCurrency
currency.description: Display currency; charges stay in UZS.

notification_prefs.title: NotificationPrefs
notification_prefs.description: Every switch, sent whole whenever one of them changed.

offers.description: Push for new offers and dispatch results.

role.description: Role name: `shipper` or `carrier` from a role switch, any role from an admin edit.

first_name.description: Null only from a profile edit, when the profile has no first name.

last_name.description: Null only from a profile edit, when the profile has no last name.

email.description: Profile edit only; null when the profile has no email.

avatar_url.description: Profile edit only. Public avatar address; null when there is none or it would expire.

updated_at.description: When the change was made. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

payload.title: UserDeleted
payload.description: An account was deleted: by its owner, without `updated_at`, or by an admin, soft or hard, with `updated_at`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

updated_at.description: Admin deletes only: when the account was deleted. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

payload.title: UserLogin
payload.description: Somebody signed in to the account: by code, password, password reset or phone change. The device fields are null when the app sent no device.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

device_id.description: Device row the session belongs to.

model.description: Device model as the app reported it.

new_device.description: True the first time this install signs in, or when a removed device comes back.

at.description: When the sign-in happened. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

payload.title: UserSessionRevoked
payload.description: Every session of the account was closed; each app must sign in again.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

reason.title: SessionRevokedReason
reason.description: Why every session of the user was closed. An operator's own note on a block stays with staff.

payload.title: UserSessionsClosed
payload.description: Some of the account's sessions were closed from another device; those installs must sign in again.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

installation_ids.description: Installs whose sessions were closed; never empty.

reason.title: SessionsClosedReason
reason.description: Why the sessions were closed; only a sign-out from another device today.

payload.title: DeviceUpserted
payload.description: A device was registered or came back after removal, or its push token changed or was cleared (signing out clears it).

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

push_token.description: FCM registration token; null when the device can no longer be pushed.

payload.title: DeviceRemoved
payload.description: The owner removed a device; its sessions are closed and it is pushed no more.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payload.title: OrgUpdated
payload.description: An organization's details changed. Only what changed is sent, besides `org_id` and `updated_at`: a role switch sends `kind` and `account_type`; the organization screen any of `name`, `legal_name`, `inn`, `contact_phone`, `address`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

updated_at.description: When the change was made. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

payload.title: VehicleUpserted
payload.description: A fleet vehicle was added or changed; the whole vehicle is sent every time.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

plate_number.description: Normalized plate: no spaces, upper case.

truck_class.description: Truck class code from the reference list.

capabilities.description: Capability codes: rear_ramp, open_top, side_curtain, tail_lift, refrigerated.

capacity_kg.description: Payload in kilograms; null when not given.

updated_at.description: When the vehicle was saved. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

payload.title: VehicleRemoved
payload.description: A fleet vehicle was removed.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payload.title: CarrierDocumentUpdated
payload.description: A carrier submitted a new version of a document; it waits for review.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

status.title: SubmittedDocumentStatus
status.description: A new version always waits for review.

version.description: Version of this document kind, from 1.

payload.title: CarrierDocumentReviewed
payload.description: An operator approved or rejected a carrier's document.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

note.description: What the operator wrote; a rejection always has one.

payload.title: CarrierDocumentExpired
payload.description: A carrier's document passed its expiry date; the hourly sweep marked it expired.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

expired_at.description: The document's expiry date. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

payload.title: CarrierDocumentExpiring
payload.description: A carrier's document expires within the warning window; sent once per document.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

expires_at.description: The document's expiry date. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

payload.title: CarrierVerificationChanged
payload.description: A carrier organization's verification moved: submitted or reopened by a replaced document (`pending`), or decided by an operator.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payload.title: SupportTicketCreated
payload.description: A user opened a support ticket.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

number.description: Reference the user sees: `T-` and six characters, for example `T-7KQ2MZ`.

order_id.description: The haul the ticket is about; null when none was named.

payload.title: SupportTicketReplied
payload.description: Support answered or closed a ticket.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

number.description: Reference the user sees: `T-` and six characters, for example `T-7KQ2MZ`.

status.title: TicketReplyStatus
status.description: The ticket's status after the reply.

payload.title: DriverStatsChanged
payload.description: A driver's completed-haul count or rating changed. Counters only grow, so a late older event is recognisable.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payload.title: LoadPosted
payload.description: A load is open on the board: just posted (one event per truck of a multi-truck post), or back on the board after its booking was cancelled, which adds `reposted: true`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

from_region_id.description: Pickup region; null when the address resolved to none.

to_region_id.description: Drop-off region; null when the address resolved to none.

truck_class.description: Truck class code from the reference list.

allow_instant.description: Whether instant dispatch may offer the load.

asking_amount.description: The shipper's price, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); null when it asks for offers.

bonus_amount.description: Shipper bonus set aside for this truck, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); null when none.

suggested_amount.description: Market price GoWay suggested, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); null when there was none.

pickup_from.description: Earliest pickup; null when not given. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

pickup_to.description: Latest pickup, also the posting's expiry; null when not given. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

pickup_lat.description: Pickup point latitude; null only when the load has no stops.

pickup_lng.description: Pickup point longitude; null only when the load has no stops.

group_id.description: Shared by the sibling loads of one multi-truck post; null for a single truck.

reposted.description: Present, and true, only when a cancelled booking put the load back.

payload.title: LoadCancelled
payload.description: The shipper withdrew an open load.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payload.title: LoadExpired
payload.description: An open load passed its expiry unbooked; the sweep closed it.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payload.title: OfferCreated
payload.description: A carrier asked for a load, or either side countered the other's price.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

kind.title: OfferKind
kind.description: Who made the offer and how.

amount.description: Offered price, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

payload.title: OfferAccepted
payload.description: An offer was accepted and became a booking; published together with `booking.created`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

driver_user_id.description: The driver who made the offer; the code allows null, an offer always has one.

payload.title: BookingCreated
payload.description: A load was booked. Two paths: an accepted offer, or an instant claim from dispatch, which adds `source: instant`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

driver_user_id.description: The driver; the offer path allows null, a booking always has one.

agreed_amount.description: Agreed price, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

source.title: BookingSource
source.description: Present only for an instant claim from dispatch; an accepted offer leaves it out.

payload.title: BookingStatusChanged
payload.description: The carrier moved the haul one step on: `en_route`, `at_pickup`, `loading`, `in_transit` or `delivered`. Completion and cancellation have their own subjects.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payload.title: BookingEtaUpdated
payload.description: The arrival window or the time the truck is free again moved: when the haul is booked (`confirmed`), at every carrier step, and on fresh GPS while `en_route` or `in_transit`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

eta_stop.description: Which stop the window is for; null when no arrival is expected any more.

eta_from.description: Earliest expected arrival at `eta_stop`; null with it. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

eta_to.description: Latest expected arrival at `eta_stop`; null with it. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

free_at.description: When the truck is expected to be empty again. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

free_region_id.description: Where the truck will be free: the drop-off region; null when unknown.

truck_class.description: The booked vehicle's truck class code.

payload.title: BookingCompleted
payload.description: A delivered haul was closed: by the shipper, by an operator, or by the auto-complete sweep. All three send the same fields. Billing charges its commission from this event.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

agreed_amount.description: Price agreed at booking, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

settled_amount.description: What the haul actually settled at: the agreed price unless another sum was confirmed, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

completed_at.description: When the haul was closed; the code allows null, it is always set. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

completed_by.title: CompletedBy
completed_by.description: Who closed the haul; `system` is the auto-complete sweep.

items.title: ChargeLine
items.description: One priced line of the haul.

amount.description: Line total, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

charges.description: Price lines; the first is always the agreed tariff.

waiting_minutes.description: Billable minutes the driver waited at pickup.

waiting_amount.description: What the waiting costs, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

waiting_billable.description: Whether the waiting is charged to the shipper.

total_amount.description: Charges plus waiting, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); the code allows null.

payload.title: BookingCancelled
payload.description: A booking ended before the cargo was loaded. The load goes back to the board. Two paths send the same fields: either side cancelling (`by` is `shipper` or `carrier`) and an operator (`by` is `operator`).

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

reason.description: What the canceller wrote; empty when nothing was written.

driver_user_id.description: Null when no driver was assigned.

payload.title: BookingAmountClaimed
payload.description: One side of a delivered haul says it settled at another sum; nothing changes until an operator decides.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

amount.description: The claimed sum, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

recorded_amount.description: The sum on record now, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

payload.title: BookingAmountSettled
payload.description: An operator accepted an amount claim; the haul now settles at `settled_amount` and billing adjusts its commission.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

shipper_org_id.description: Null only when the load could not be read.

previous_amount.description: The sum on record before, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

settled_amount.description: The sum the operator settled on, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

payload.title: BookingReturnLoads
payload.description: Hours before a truck is empty: loads are waiting in the region where it unloads. Sent once per haul.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

region_id.description: The drop-off region, where the truck will be free.

heads_home.description: How many of them go back to the haul's pickup region.

free_at.description: When the truck is expected to be empty. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

payload.title: RatingCreated
payload.description: The shipper rated a completed haul; sent once per haul.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

target.title: RatingTarget
target.description: Who was rated; only the driver today.

driver_user_id.description: The rated driver; the code allows null, a booking always has one.

payload.title: WalletEntryPosted
payload.description: A line was written to an organization's wallet ledger.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

amount.description: Signed change of the balance, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

balance.description: Balance after the line, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); negative means debt.

booking_id.description: The haul the line is for; null for lines not tied to a haul.

payload.title: WalletEligibilityChanged
payload.description: An organization's wallet started or stopped being allowed to receive offers. One event per user of the organization, or a single event with a null `user_id` when billing knows no user of it yet.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

user_id.description: Null when billing's replica holds no user of the organization.

balance.description: Wallet balance in so'm; negative means debt.

debt_limit.description: How far below zero the balance may go, so'm.

reason.description: Why offers stopped; null when the wallet is eligible.

payload.title: WalletToppedUp
payload.description: An operator took cash for an organization's wallet and issued a receipt.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

amount.description: Cash received, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

balance.description: Balance after the top-up, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); negative means debt.

payload.title: NotificationCreated
payload.description: A message landed in a user's notification feed: from an event, or from an admin announcement (`kind: announcement`).

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payload.title: DevicePushFailed
payload.description: The push provider rejected a device's token as dead; the device should be shown as unreachable.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payload.title: RegionChanged
payload.description: An admin opened or closed a region for the marketplace.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payload.title: SettingsChanged
payload.description: An admin changed or reset runtime settings of one service. Published by goway-lib for goway-auth, goway-loads, goway-billing and goway-notify, and by goway-realtime itself, with the same fields.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event: the outbox row id from a Python service, a random UUID from goway-realtime. Consumers dedupe on it.

service.description: The service whose settings changed, for example `goway-loads`.

by.description: The admin who changed them; null when not known.

payload.title: DriverOnline
payload.description: A driver opened or changed a line and waits for instant offers.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, a random UUID stamped by goway-lib-rs when it publishes. Consumers dedupe on it.

bidirectional.description: Also takes loads on the way back.

expires_at.description: When the line ends, unix milliseconds.

payload.title: DriverOffline
payload.description: A driver left the line: went offline, the line expired, the grace after a disconnect ran out, or the sessions were revoked.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, a random UUID stamped by goway-lib-rs when it publishes. Consumers dedupe on it.

org_id.description: From the presence record, which always has it.

payload.title: LocationSampled
payload.description: A driver's GPS position during an active booking, sampled every `location_sample_seconds` as evidence of the haul.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, a random UUID stamped by goway-lib-rs when it publishes. Consumers dedupe on it.

recorded_at.description: When the position was sampled, RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds.

payload.title: DispatchOffered
payload.description: An instant load was offered to a wave of drivers on its line, so a driver whose app is in the background still sees it. Loss-tolerant: the socket frame is the offer itself.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, a random UUID stamped by goway-lib-rs when it publishes. Consumers dedupe on it.

truck_class.description: Truck class code from the reference list.

amount.description: The load's fixed price, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

deadline_at.description: Answer deadline, unix milliseconds in server time.
